justification: The evidence page is rebuilt for a planner: an at-a-glance box first, the walk on a labelled number line, cards for the paragraphs a person must check (with the flood and pipeline distances already in the data), the council's rules as cards, and the law's wording and method folded. The council-files table is removed on purpose. The evidence data gains a plain topic title for each paragraph and the instrument's name. No planning number is typed: every figure, limit, distance and margin shown comes from the payload.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_evidence_statement.py -q -o addopts= ; cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/components/evidence-statement-page.test.tsx __tests__/lib/evidence-summary.test.ts __tests__/components/evidence-sections.test.tsx ; npx tsc --noEmit -p .
falsifiable_check.expected: 66 backend tests and 122 frontend tests pass; tsc prints no errors.
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A paragraph title or the instrument name is dropped from the data, a distance is shown in the wrong unit or rounded to 1000 m, a not-checked paragraph is shown as clear, a clause label not checked against its page is shown as a clause, the clear count is wrong, or a tick label sits on the limit label.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Ten hand breakages each turned a test red and were restored: the distance rounding, the sentence capital, the not-checked What-we-found line always shown, the next step shown for a clear row, an unchecked clause shown as a clause, the tick overlap guard (found green at first, a test added, then red), the clear count, the paragraph title, the instrument name, and the instrument type guard. Rendered with real data (28 Selwyn Street Pymble and Windsor) in headless Chrome at desktop width and at 480 px, the smallest it allows; the phone view has no element wider than the window.

pre_impl.existing_data: The evidence endpoint already returns the rows, the walk, the controls and the facts for flood and pipeline (PR 1678; this branch is stacked on it).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: An earlier mock-up named the wrong clause and said the tool does not check for gas pipelines; both were corrected from the code before building.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: New: the summary helpers and five section components, a title per paragraph and the instrument name. Removed: the council-files table and the older single-table layout. Unchanged: the route map data and the payload checks for older servers.
pre_impl.external_source_error: An older server answer without the new fields still loads: every new field is optional, and a present field of the wrong shape shows the error line.
pre_impl.frontend_type: title, facts, law_instrument and walk fields are optional in the type and checked by the guard.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A planner scans the box for the answer; a paragraph this tool could not check is shown as needing a person, never as clear.

functions.name: exclusions
functions.input: the area check output and the law facts
functions.output: one row per live paragraph, now with a plain title
functions.if_none: A paragraph with no listed title gets none and the page shows its clause.

functions.name: manual_checks
functions.input: the rows of the evidence table
functions.output: the rows not cleared, with their title
functions.if_none: No such row gives an empty list.

functions.name: build
functions.input: area, controls, files and the facts
functions.output: the evidence data including the law's instrument name
functions.if_none: No instrument in the saved facts gives none, never a guessed name.

functions.name: distanceWords
functions.input: a distance in metres as a number
functions.output: metres, or kilometres to one decimal, rounded before the unit is chosen
functions.if_none: A bad number gives a words line saying it could not be read.

functions.name: walkVerdict
functions.output: over, within, straddles or unknown with the limit and range
functions.if_none: A missing limit or range gives unknown, never within.

functions.name: buildScale
functions.output: percent positions for the scale and its ticks
functions.if_none: Any missing number gives none and the scale is not drawn.

functions.name: tally
functions.input: the list of exclusion rows from the payload
functions.output: counts of clear, excluded and others, with the clear rows
functions.if_none: An empty list of rows gives zero in every count.

functions.name: lgaName
functions.input: the council name from the data
functions.output: the same letters in title case

functions.name: factLines
functions.input: the facts of a row and its detail
functions.output: plain lines for flood and pipeline distances
functions.if_none: An absent field adds no line.

functions.name: RangeScale
functions.input: the walk verdict with its limit and range
functions.output: a labelled number line with a text label for every mark
functions.if_none: Missing numbers draw nothing at all.

functions.name: ControlsSection
functions.input: the evidence data from the server
functions.output: one card per council rule with its page
functions.if_none: No controls or an unreadable source says so in words.

functions.name: AtAGlance
functions.input: the evidence data from the server
functions.output: three summary tiles and a bottom line
functions.if_none: No range shows No range, never a number.

functions.name: EvidenceStatement
functions.input: the lat and lng in the address bar
functions.output: the full evidence page for the lot
functions.if_none: A failed or malformed answer shows an error line.

values.value: title, law_instrument, facts and walk fields from the payload
values.if_missing: Left out of the page; never filled in.

break_it.scenario: A paragraph the tool could not check is shown as clear.
break_it.what_happens: A planner would skip a check that needs a person.
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated: not-checked rows are cards with a next step and counted as needing a person.
break_it.how: Tests on the tally, the card and the at-a-glance pill.

break_it.scenario: An older server answer without the new fields.
break_it.what_happens: The page could crash or show empty cards.
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated: fields are optional and the page tests use a payload without them.
break_it.how: The page test file loads an older-shaped payload.

break_it.scenario: A distance just under a kilometre reads 1000 m.
break_it.what_happens: An odd figure on a legal-style page.
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated: rounding happens before the unit is chosen.

break_it.what_happens: The scale becomes hard to read.
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated: shorter labels on small screens, cards use min-w-0, a tick near the limit is not drawn.
break_it.how: Rendered with real data at 480 px; a test for the tick guard.

break_it.scenario: The council-files table is wanted back.
break_it.mitigated: Removed on purpose at the user's request; the data field is still validated.

break_it.scenario: The page deploys before the data, or the reverse.
break_it.mitigated: Mitigated: optional fields, and the page leaves out what is missing.

residual_risk: 1) The phone view was rendered at 480 px, not 390 px, because headless Chrome will not go below 482 px; the layout has no element wider than the window. 2) The flood and pipeline data this page shows shipped in PR 1678, already on main. 3) The plain titles are my short topic labels read from the law's wording of each paragraph; the law's own words sit beside them. 4) The council-files table was removed, so a planner no longer sees which council files are held.

post_merge.manual_verify: Open /reports/evidence-statement?lat=-33.735496841364196&lng=151.13852529738543 after both deploys and check the box, scale and cards.
